transcript.content: Hello, I am Dr. Smith. Could you please tell me what brings you in to see me today?

No matter how interested I am, I can’t keep my attention on job training or applications long enough to finish them. I really want to get my career in automotive work going, but I just can't seem to focus long enough to get through the paperwork or the studying.
Have you struggled with these difficulties in staying focused and finishing tasks since you were a child, or is this a more recent change in your life?

It definitely goes all the way back to when I was a kid. In elementary school, my teachers were constantly moving my seat and sending notes home because I'd blurt out answers, wander around the classroom, and always lose my homework. I wasn't trying to misbehave, but I just couldn't seem to stay on track even back then.
Do you still find yourself frequently interrupting others, feeling restless, or acting on impulses without thinking in your daily life now?

Yes, definitely. If I have to sit still for too long at the library or job center, I feel this pent-up energy in my body and just have to get up and pace around to take the edge off. I also constantly jump in and cut people off during family talks about money before they even finish, only realizing I've done it when they look annoyed.
